name: Orkla India Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1996, Orkla India Limited is an Indian food company, offering a diverse range of food products, from breakfast to lunch and dinner, snacks, beverages, and desserts.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Profile[1]
Orkla India is a multi-category Indian food company with decades of experience, offering a diverse range of packaged foods catering to all meal occasions — from breakfast to desserts.

pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 28.4% CAGR over last 5 years
cons: Company has a low return on equity of 11.1% over last 3 years.
